Direct Metallurgical Verification

Gold Melting &
Fire Assay Cupellation

The undisputed gold standard of purity analysis. In-house induction melting fuses and homogenizes client lots at 1,150 °C, followed by rigorous cupellation and nitric acid parting for certified parts-per-thousand accuracy.

Stage 01 · Thermal HomogenizationStandard: ISO 11426:2021

Induction Melting

High-Frequency Crucible Thermal Fusion

Raw jewelry scrap, doré bars and refining lots are fused inside high-purity clay-graphite crucibles. Thermal induction homogenizes the alloy so drill-core or vacuum pin-tube samples represent 100% of the lot.

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear Answers on Gold Testing & Assay

Everything you need to know about fire assay precision, testing turnaround, scrap gold valuation, and our Dubai Gold Souq facility.

Fire assay (cupellation) is the classical gravimetric method used by refiners, central banks and hallmarking authorities worldwide to determine the exact gold fineness of a sample. A weighed micro-sample is fused with lead foil and silver (inquartation), cupelled at over 1,000 °C so base metals oxidize into a porous cupel, and parted in nitric acid to leave pure gold that is weighed on an analytical micro-balance.
